title: DeepSeek Infra 5.0 Native Rust/Go Runtime Readiness Assessment
assessment_scope: Repository snapshot only; this file is not release evidence.

blockers.detail: Chat completions are stubbed, SSE is unsupported, and /api/* is not proxied to Go.
deepseekd exposes shadow foundations, not the complete production /api/* control plane.
Storage, transfer, federation, proof, and worker effects remain non-authoritative foundations.
Current Rust DTOs do not establish byte/semantic parity for object-set-v1, Receipt v4, Commit v4, federation, or evidence-proof-v2.
The repository has no reproducible protoc-generated Go and Rust gRPC bindings wired into the native services.
The canonical server, desktop, and Android production paths still package or start Python.
The declared Compose topology is not a verified edge/control/worker production topology.
Native Three-MinIO, two-Fleet/four-MinIO, and SIGKILL/takeover evidence has not been produced.
No exact-head CI and Evidence Assembly artifacts qualify this native runtime snapshot.
Zero-Python and unique-writer invariants have targets but no non-vacuous measured artifacts.
